[SWS_CRYPT_20003]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
FC Crypto
shall provide all cryptographic al-
gorithms to generate, validate, and process certificates, which are used in the sys-
tem. Depending on the certificate the
X.509 Provider
uses the corresponding
Crypto Provider
. However, the
X.509 Provider
can either directly access the
cryptographic algorithm or use the exposed interfaces provided by the
CryptoAPI
.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02204, RS_CRYPTO_02306)
